# Xorg's key-width resizing in XKB SetMap (XkbResizeKeyType, issue #171 phase 4c):
# Xvfb -noreset, fresh server per case, layout=us,ru option=grp:alt_shift_toggle
# server: X.Org version 21.1.24 (xdpyinfo); `Xvfb -version` -> "Unrecognized option: -version" (not supported by this build)
# pacman -Q: xkeyboard-config 2.48-1 xorg-server-xvfb 21.1.24-1
# each case: setxkbmap -rules evdev -model pc105 -layout us,ru -option grp:alt_shift_toggle;
# then tools/xkb-mutation-probe.c -x xreq:xkb-setmap-resize/NAME.bin (the actor, after its
# XkbUseExtension). The request is built by this script (the '## case' line says what it
# changes); output grammar as in xorg-xkbcomp-steps.txt, the state before is
# xorg-xkb-pristine.txt's layout=us,ru case.
